item.title: The Hardest Online Course I Ever Took
item.description:
If I had to choose the most brutally difficult course in my entire self-learning journey, it would undoubtedly be the Udacity Self-Driving Car Engineer Nanodegree (SDCND).

Born in 1996 with only a Diploma in Business Studies, I had zero Computer Science (CS) background. I had never taken university-level advanced math or higher physics. Yet, I not only conquered this Autonomous Driving program—a course that leaves many CS master’s students struggling—but also became one of its top early graduates globally.

item.title: My Journey with MIT DeepTraffic: Ranking #1 and Winning the Udacity Self-Driving Car Tuition Waiver
item.description:
Back in early 2017, I had the incredible opportunity to participate in MIT’s 6.S094: Deep Learning for Self-Driving Cars competition—DeepTraffic. It was an exhilarating experience that marked a significant milestone in my journey with AI and autonomous driving technology.

Leaderboard Achievements

DeepTraffic 1.0 DeepTraffic 1.1

Achieving #1 on DeepTraffic 1.0 & 1.1

In January 2017, after countless hours of hyperparameter tuning, model iteration, and deep reinforcement learning experiments, I managed to reach the #1 spot on the DeepTraffic 1.0 leaderboard under the username Instagram: Jorcus96 with a speed score of 75.38 MPH.
